investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Novaent Pay (digital banking); Platform: Google Cloud asia-southeast1 (zones asia-southeast1-a/asia-southeast1-b/asia-southeast1-c); network range 10.18.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster novaen-prod-asiaso (GKE); Database: mysql server kyc-db-01 reachable from the application network only through firewall rule allow-kyc-to-db; infrastructure is managed with Terraform applied from CI; Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
